create_OpenImagesDataModule: create an OpenImagesDataModule instance with a root path, batch size, and image size for training
build_OpenImagesDataModule_custom_transf: build an OpenImagesDataModule with custom train and val transforms instead of default ones
setup_OpenImagesDataModule: setup the OpenImagesDataModule to initialize train and eval datasets from OpenImagesV6
run_train_dataloader: run the train_dataloader method to get a shuffled DataLoader with prefetch for training
run_val_dataloader: run the val_dataloader method to get a DataLoader for validation with optional custom batch size
